title: Bright Sound Translation
sonic_description: Bright, crisp sound with prominent high frequencies and quick transient response
why: High filter cutoff preserves all harmonics. Fast attack emphasizes transients. Lower sustain and decay create punch rather than sustain.
how_to_apply: Use for lead sounds, plucks, and sounds that need to cut through a mix. Be careful with filter resonance at high cutoff to avoid harshness.
